units: <cite ref="Gittin 57b:6">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ גר תושב היה</he> N. was a convert &c., v. <cite ref="C01225"><he>גֵּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 40a:6">Ned. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>שיזדמנו לו ריעים כנ׳ וכ׳</he> that he may meet with friends like those of N. who cured him of his leprosy.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:28">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; a. fr.
